title: Independent S0/T1 MECP test for the first spin-inversion event in 1a dimerization
difficulty_reasons: The crossing is not supplied and must be found from a dimeric biradical search over distinct intermolecular orientations, then validated as a genuine S0/T1 event.
Each advanced candidate requires independent optimization, frequency, spin-state, crossing, connectivity, and energy-reference diagnostics, with a truthful bounded-failure branch.

paper.title: Visible-Light-Induced Cycloaddition and Proton Transfer of 1,4-Dihydropyridines: An Integrated Experimental and DFT Study

required_deliverables.description: Validated candidate search, crossing/barrier result or bounded failure, diagnostics, and conclusion.
